name: small-errors-large-residuals
description: Frozen before test scoring. Do not edit after protocol.sha256 is written.

weak_form.burgers_spatial: real Fourier modes k = 0..K_phi (cosine and sine for k > 0), periodic interval
weak_form.heat_spatial: Dirichlet sine modes sin(p pi x/L) sin(q pi y/L), 1 <= p,q <= K_phi
weak_form.heat_boundary: homogeneous Dirichlet, unchanged from the shipped solver
weak_form.gram: G_mn = <psi_m, psi_n> with the same quadrature as r_m
weak_form.burgers_psi: -d_t phi - nu d_xx phi (linear adjoint; the residual still includes the convective term)
weak_form.reference_norm: space-time quadrature L2 of the reference field, not of the prediction
weak_form.citation: Messenger and Bortz, arXiv:2007.02848, for the polynomial bump; spatial factors are eigenmodes so the Dirichlet boundary term vanishes

noise.smooth_time_detail: Each spatial coefficient is an independent trigonometric polynomial of degree n_time_modes on [0, T], including the constant mode m = 0. The error is not frozen in time.
noise.white: i.i.d. Gaussian at every node and time. Heat noise is then set to zero on the Dirichlet boundary and rescaled so the relative L2 is exact.

zero_field_rule.statement: The zero field satisfies both homogeneous PDEs exactly, so its strong and weak residuals are zero. It is reported, and it is excluded from the best-trivial-baseline anchor M_0 for residual metrics.

scaled_score.M_ref_residual: residual of the reference solver trajectory

verdict.rule: The legacy untrusted flag (strong residual > 1) survives the weak form only if the weak residual is strictly greater than the mean white-noise weak residual interpolated, in log-log coordinates, to the field's relative L2. If the relative L2 is below the smallest calibrated level, survival is not called.

statistics.paired_test: two-sided sign-flip permutation test on the mean paired difference

training.selection: lowest validation relative L2; ties keep the earlier trial
training.loss: data MSE only; test split is not read during training or selection
training.fno_note: existing BurgersFNO / HeatFNO, time as output channels
training.unet_note: one-level U-Net, circular padding on Burgers, zero padding on heat, Dirichlet walls reset
training.deeponet_note: branch MLP on the initial condition; trunk MLP on time, a fixed coefficient scale (nu/0.05 or alpha/0.2), and fixed Fourier features (Burgers k=1..4, heat sine p=1..3). Not tuned on the test set.

symbol_check.formula: E|R|^2 = s^2 (2/dt^2 + d(2d+1) alpha^2/h^4) for the midpoint heat scheme, d=2

hypotheses: H1: at epsilon 0.01, strong white residual exceeds strong smooth residual (paired, both PDEs)
H2: heat i.i.d. second moment matches the formula within 10 percent
H3: Burgers i.i.d. second moment matches the formula within 10 percent
H4: strong white residual grows from the coarsest to the finest spatial grid
H5: weak white residual grows by a smaller factor than the strong residual across that grid
H6: weak residual at coefficient scale 0 exceeds the weak residual at scale 1
